$comment: The mutation that reddens each test that belongs to no single map entry. The overlay holds that record per entry (AGENTS.md §7) and cannot hold this one: rules-factory decision 0015's merge rule 1 refuses an overlay key that is not an entry id, and rule 2 refuses a field outside status, implementedIn, tests and the owner's rulings. docs/decisions/0007-a-test-that-belongs-to-no-entry-records-its-mutation-beside-the-tests.md is the decision. RecordedMutationTests checks that nothing on this engine's test surface is missing from one record or the other, and that nothing here names a test that no longer runs.

`RulesKernel.Randomness` 0.3.0 was pinned in `Directory.Packages.props`, referenced from `src/FaaPart107/FaaPart107.csproj`, and used from `Ruleset.cs` (`public static Type Drawn => typeof(RulesKernel.Randomness.Pcg32State);`), so the built engine assembly referenced the package the corpus's `randomness: none` declaration forbids (rules-factory decision 0019). It is the one mutation here that cannot be a substitution inside the source alone: an assembly reference the compiler does not emit unless a type is used. The locked restore was relaxed for that run only (`dotnet restore -p:RestoreLockedMode=false`) and the working tree, lock files included, was restored afterwards and re-restored locked. This test went red on `Assert.DoesNotContain("RulesKernel.Randomness", referenced)` -- `Failed!  - Failed:     1, Passed:   683, Skipped:     0, Total:   684` on both net8.0 and net10.0, and nothing else in the suite went red

That is the third of its three clauses. The first two -- that the identity is deterministic without randomness and names no random algorithm -- are fixed by the `ReplayCompatibilityIdentity` constructor overload this engine calls, and this substitution does not move them; what moves that property of the engine is `The_engine_assembly_references_the_kernel_and_never_the_randomness_package`'s mutation above

This check makes four assertions and each was watched failing on its own, because an xUnit test stops at the first assertion that fires: a mutation that trips an earlier one proves nothing about a later one. The four, in the order the test makes them, with the error message each printed. **(1) Nothing runs unnamed.** One row of this file stopped naming a test that runs (`"test": "DeterminismTests.The_same_request_resolves_the_same_way_every_time_but_not_under_this_name"` for `"test": "DeterminismTests.The_same_request_resolves_the_same_way_every_time"`), so that test ran with no record -- `Failed!  - Failed:     1, Passed:   683, Skipped:     0, Total:   684` on both net8.0 and net10.0, and nothing else in the suite went red, on `these tests run and no record names the mutation that reddens them, so nobody has watched them fail (AGENTS.md §7). A test that proves one map entry's rule belongs in that entry's `tests` in corpus-map.overlay.json; one that proves something no single entry owns belongs in tests/FaaPart107.Tests/cross-cutting-mutations.json (docs/decisions/0007): DeterminismTests.The_same_request_resolves_the_same_way_every_time`. **(2) Nothing is named that does not run.** A row naming a method no class declares was ADDED to this file (`"test": "DeterminismTests.A_test_this_engine_does_not_have"`) rather than an existing row being renamed, which is what makes this the second assertion's mutation and not the first's again: every test that runs is still named, so assertion 1 passes and the record's claim to evidence for a test that does not exist is what fires -- `Failed!  - Failed:     1, Passed:   683, Skipped:     0, Total:   684` on both net8.0 and net10.0, and nothing else in the suite went red, on `cross-cutting-mutations.json names tests that no longer exist: DeterminismTests.A_test_this_engine_does_not_have`. **(3) One record each.** A cross-cutting row was copied into an entry's `tests` in `corpus-map.overlay.json` (`DeterminismTests.The_same_request_resolves_the_same_way_every_time` added under `speed-within-limit`), so two records named one test and could disagree about it -- `Failed!  - Failed:     1, Passed:   683, Skipped:     0, Total:   684` on both net8.0 and net10.0, and nothing else in the suite went red, on `these tests are named by an entry's overlay row and by cross-cutting-mutations.json, so two records can disagree about one test: DeterminismTests.The_same_request_resolves_the_same_way_every_time`. **(4) No row is empty of a mutation.** One `mutation` string was blanked (the `The_evaluation_does_not_collapse_to_a_boolean_and_offers_no_way_to_claim_one` row's, `""` for its text) -- `Failed!  - Failed:     1, Passed:   683, Skipped:     0, Total:   684` on both net8.0 and net10.0, and nothing else in the suite went red, on `these cross-cutting rows record no mutation, and a test nobody has seen go red is not evidence: OperationEvaluatorTests.The_evaluation_does_not_collapse_to_a_boolean_and_offers_no_way_to_claim_one`. Each mutation was applied to the committed tree, built, run over the whole suite on both target frameworks, and reverted, with `git status --porcelain` clean afterwards. That is this check failing on each of the conditions it exists for, observed rather than asserted (issue #98's criterion 3).
